title: Birds in the Dark Barn
lines: A girl and her dad park by a barn.
It is dark and hard to spot the lamp.
Dad digs in a bin for it.
First he trips on a jar of corn.
The corn spills all on the dirt.
Then a bird lands on the corn.
More birds turn up in the barn.
The girl claps her hands hard.
Dad sorts the corn back in the jar.
It was a short but hard job.

questions.ask: How did the corn end up on the dirt?
questions.listenFor: Dad tripped on the jar while digging in a bin for the lamp. Two steps back in the story, so let them reread.

questions.ask: What did the girl do to make the birds go?
questions.listenFor: She clapped her hands hard. It is one short line and easy to skim past.

questions.ask: Do you think the birds will come back? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason, like the corn is back in the jar now, or the birds liked it too much.
